evidenceClasses.SOURCE_VERIFIED_BASELINE: Exact frozen v0.3 relation identity or pinned backend-surface finding.
evidenceClasses.SYMBOLIC_LOWER_BOUND: A structural expression without compiled counts or measurements.
evidenceClasses.UNKNOWN_NOT_COMPILED: A required count or layout value unavailable because no conversion exists.
evidenceClasses.NOT_ATTEMPTED_BY_GATE: Work prohibited because no SP-10 candidate became eligible.

baselineFacts: One frozen withdrawal calls the application hash 22 times: one nullifier, one note commitment, and 20 level-bound Merkle nodes.
Those calls use different framed payloads and expand to 240 rate-four Poseidon2 sponge permutations in A0; this is not evidence of a qualified fixed-compression finalist.
The public partition is 64 canonical BabyBear values ordered scope, root, nullifier hash, payout digest.
The private partition is nullifier secret, trapdoor, leaf index, 20 path bits, and 20 sibling digests.
The application chooses the expected public statement; a proof-supplied public vector is not authoritative.

schemaBoundary.purpose: Describe the intended repeated-block interface only.

backendEvidenceScope.spartanWhir: The pinned landscape record establishes generic R1CS support and the absence of a special PQTC repeated-block API; no source is copied here.
backendEvidenceScope.flock: The pinned landscape record establishes removal of the application Keccak encoder and its proof-benchmark consumers, not absence of every low-level Keccak benchmark file.
backendEvidenceScope.license: The pinned Spartan-WHIR repository lacks adequate inspected license metadata; copying remains prohibited.

measurementPolicy.allowed: Exact source identities and symbolic structural expressions.
measurementPolicy.prohibited: Invented variables, constraints, nonzeros, glue counts, offsets, expansion ratios, sumcheck rounds, proof bytes, gas, time, RSS, or security results.
measurementPolicy.numericConsumption: The 22-call and 240-permutation values describe the frozen control only; all conversion rows are nonnumeric and NOT_ATTEMPTED_BY_GATE.

nonClaims: No backend preserves this schema merely because it accepts generic R1CS or Boolean constraints.
No historical Flock result is a current PQTC, hiding, or EVM result.
No conversion or backend passed the SP-21 gate.
